This is the {{tl|ambox/core}} sub-template.

Do not use this template directly, use {{tl|ambox}} instead.

This template is called from {{tl|ambox}}. It holds almost all of the code for {{tlf|ambox}}, while {{tlf|ambox}} does parameter preprocessing. Thus simplifying the code in {{tlf|ambox/core}}.

For more documentation see {{tl|ambox}}.
